description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.
